detailed_description:
The environment transforms into an arid, sun-bleached post-apocalyptic landscape featuring dry, severely cracked mudflats bordering a calm, deep-blue body of water. Across the lake sits a desolate hill dotted with dilapidated stone ruins under an open, hazy sky lit by harsh, direct sunlight.

Whenever present, the humanoid figure becomes <Subject 1>, a survivor clad in layered brown survival gear, goggles, and a breathing apparatus. Any quadruped proxy renders as <Subject 2>, a worn pack horse fitted with rustic leather harnesses and salvaged armor. Any rectangular settlement building appears as <Subject 3>, showcasing weathered plaster walls and corroded metal roofing. Any prominent spire renders as <Subject 4>, forming a crumbling masonry watchtower overlooking the terrain. Roadside lighting posts correspond to <Subject 5>, styled as twisted wooden branches suspending rusty metal lamps. Background vegetation manifests as <Subject 6>, taking the shape of parched, upright cypress trees.

<Video 1> dictates all character movements, visibility, object placements, and camera framing throughout the scene.

content.text:
subject_definitions:
<Video 1>: Source/control video providing the source proxies, spatial layout, motion, timing, visibility, and camera framing.
<Picture 1>: Standalone target appearance reference providing anime/painterly style, warm sunlit lighting, bright palette, Mediterranean village environment, and material textures.
<Subject 1>: Rendered target tricycle defined in <Picture 2>, where the top panel shows the minimalist source tricycle carrier in <Video 1> and the bottom panel supplies the light blue tricycle with a wicker basket box, red-and-white checkered cloth lining, white saddle, and white grips.
<Subject 2>: Rendered target vegetable crate defined in <Picture 3>, where the top panel shows the rough vegetable crate proxy in <Video 1> and the bottom panel provides the dark green slatted wooden crate filled with leeks and round produce resting on a wooden stand.
<Subject 3>: Rendered target stone bridge defined in <Picture 4>, where the top panel shows the plain grey bridge proxy in <Video 1> and the bottom panel supplies the arched sandstone pedestrian bridge with textured block masonry.
<Subject 4>: Rendered target market stall defined in <Picture 5>, where the top panel shows the grey stall proxy in <Video 1> and the bottom panel provides the wooden market stand with a yellow-and-white striped fabric canopy and fruit crates.
<Subject 5>: Rendered target village building defined in <Picture 6>, where the top panel shows the monochrome block building proxy in <Video 1> and the bottom panel supplies the cream-colored stucco house with blue wooden shutters, terracotta tiled roof, and floral window boxes.
<Subject 6>: Rendered target planter box defined in <Picture 7>, where the top panel shows the simple planter proxy in <Video 1> and the bottom panel supplies the pale stone planter box filled with green flowering shrubs.

summary:
[video editing] The minimalist grey 3D environment and geometric proxies are transformed into a vibrant, sunlit Mediterranean townscape in an anime painterly style, while <Video 1> governs all time-varying movement, camera framing, and object placement.

retention_analysis:
<Video 1>: partially_preserved - Retains spatial layout, motion trajectories, object positions, timing, and camera framing, while replacing basic proxy materials and shapes with stylized rendered assets.
<Picture 1>: attribute_transfer - Transfers painterly anime rendering style, sunny Mediterranean atmosphere, warm color palette, and architectural finishes to the scene.
<Subject 1>: partially_preserved - Retains the three-wheeled tricycle chassis and steering geometry from the top panel while adopting the light blue paint, wicker basket, and checkered lining from the bottom panel of <Picture 2>.
<Subject 2>: partially_preserved - Retains the slatted crate structure and produce layout from the top panel while applying painted textures and vibrant natural colors from the bottom panel of <Picture 3>.
<Subject 3>: partially_preserved - Retains the arched bridge silhouette and path geometry from the top panel while receiving textured sandstone masonry and warm color tones from the bottom panel of <Picture 4>.
<Subject 4>: partially_preserved - Retains the canopy stall framework from the top panel while adding yellow-and-white awning stripes, wooden grain, and detailed fruit textures from the bottom panel of <Picture 5>.
<Subject 5>: partially_preserved - Retains the building massing and window/door placements from the top panel while replacing plain walls with warm stucco, terracotta tiles, and shuttered windows with flower boxes from the bottom panel of <Picture 6>.
<Subject 6>: partially_preserved - Retains the box shape and hedge volume from the top panel while adding stone planter textures and blossoming flowering foliage from the bottom panel of <Picture 7>.

detailed_description:
The setting is a picturesque Mediterranean village rendered in a warm, sunny anime aesthetic influenced by <Picture 1>. Paved stone streets run between two-story townhouses adorned with warm cream plaster, terracotta tile roofs, bright blue shutters, and colorful window flower boxes. Bright direct sunlight casts soft dappled tree shadows across the stone pavers beneath a clear blue sky.

Wherever the tricycle carrier is present, <Subject 1> manifests as a sky-blue three-wheeled cycle equipped with a woven wicker front basket lined with red-and-white checkered gingham cloth, a white padded saddle, and matching handlebar grips. When the vegetable stand structure appears, <Subject 2> renders as a dark green slatted wooden crate holding leeks and citrus fruit on an amber timber bench. Should an arched pedestrian walkway occur, <Subject 3> forms an arching bridge built from warm-toned masonry stone blocks. Where market stalls are situated, <Subject 4> becomes an open-sided fruit stand featuring a yellow-and-white striped fabric canopy over wooden crates of assorted fresh produce. Throughout the street corridors, <Subject 5> defines each town residence with textured beige stucco, terracotta eaves, blue louvered shutters, and overflowing floral sill planters. Along exterior walls or curbsides, <Subject 6> provides rectangular stone-textured planter boxes filled with lush green shrubs speckled with pink and white blossoms.

All object placements, visibility states, movement paths, speed changes, and camera movements are governed entirely by <Video 1>.
